messages:
PagerBot: [ALERT] hosted-api us-east request-queue growth > 5k, GPU pool 'hosted-gpu-pool-1' available=0/24; p95 generation latency > 15s; autoscaler errors detected.
Linda SRE: digging in. seeing queue climb, p50->p95 spike. paging now. any immediate mitigation ideas?
Raj Infra: I'm seeing autoscaler logs: repeated failures creating node - error from cloud API: quotaExceeded -> "Insufficient GPU quota in us-east-1". also a couple of 503s from mediator.
Marco Runtime: Runtime reports high KV cache evictions and long scheduling latencies. Model shard placement is stuck waiting for nodes.
Emily CS: Customer impact: 3 enterprise tenants reporting elevated 502/504s, several PLG apps seeing timeouts and retry storms. CS is fielding p1s.
Linda SRE: Ok immediate plan: 1) enable global ingress rate-limit to shed burst traffic to 500rps 2) enable model-variant fallback to cpu-quantized for low-priority routes 3) throttle non-authenticated PLG keys. who can flip these?
Raj Infra: I can flip rate-limit and throttle PLG keys via config-store. applying now.
Raj Infra: sudo /bin/reload-config --service=ingress --rate-limit=500
Raj Infra: done. Confirming 503->429 on some clients (expected). queue growth rate reduced slightly.
Marco Runtime: I'll enable fallback to cpu-quantized variant for modelGallery/v2 routes: toggling feature-flag.
Marco Runtime: patching runtime: PATCH /runtime/flags {"model_fallback":"cpu_quantized","priority":"low"}
Marco Runtime: fallback enabled for low-priority. Observability: per-token cost lower, p95 on critical routes unchanged.
Linda SRE: Autoscaler still failing. Raj can you check quota request ticket? We need temporary capacity: either scale down per-instance GPU memory to allow more pods per node, or spin up smaller accelerator types. Thoughts?
Raj Infra: Filed quota request with cloud: INC-76432. Cloud responded ETA ~ 4 hours. We can temporarily spin up older-generation GPUs from quota pool (g4->g5?) but that requires image rebuild for runtime. Alternatively we can route traffic to Dedicated pool (if capacity) — checking.
OpsBot: Dedicated pool 'dedicated-east-1' capacity status: available_gpus=12, reserved_customers=8, spillable=3.
Marco Runtime: We can safe-route low-priority traffic to dedicated pool with a routing policy change. This will cost customers though. Need approval from Product/GTM for billing implications.
Emily CS: Approve temporary routing for non-SLA tenants. Notify affected customers. CS will prepare messaging.
Linda SRE: Marco/Raj proceed to route PLG/non-enterprise traffic to dedicated pool. Leave enterprise on hosted GPU only.
Raj Infra: Executing routing change: /infra/routing set --from=hosted/us-east --to=dedicated-east --match=plg_keys
Raj Infra: routing change applied. Seeing gradual drain of queued requests. p95 for plg paths dropping from 22s -> 6s.
Marco Runtime: Noting some errors on dedicated pool: kernel mismatch on one instance; restarting agent on that node.
Marco Runtime: node agent restart done. dedicated pool stable.
Linda SRE: Customer impact update: enterprise tenants still seeing elevated latency on critical routes (we didn't route those). CS & product reaching out to affected accounts. Any way to accelerate recovery for enterprise?
Marco Runtime: As a short shot, can we serve enterprise requests from a smaller model variant (same API) to reduce GPU memory? That's a config-only rollout. I'll prepare a canary.
Marco Runtime: Canary in place for 2 enterprise tenants. p95 dropped by ~40% for canary traffic.
Linda SRE: Nice. Next: We'll keep routing PLG->dedicated, enable enterprise canary fallback, and continue to wait on quota. Postmortem owners: eng-runtime (Marco), infra (Raj), oncall SRE (Linda).
Emily CS: Drafting customer comms and status page blurb. ETA for next update 30m.
Sam Oncall: I'm taking second-shift oncall. Linda handing off in 10 minutes. Short summary for handoff: autoscaler failing due to quotaExceeded, rate-limits and PLG routing applied, dedicated pool absorbing low-priority traffic, enterprise canary fallback running. open actions: monitor quota ticket, validate dedicated pool stability, verify no regressions from fallback.
Linda SRE: Handoff accepted. Leaving an incident note in ops-log: INCIDENT 2148765432 - Request flood mitigations applied. Follow-ups: automate fallback routing, improve autoscaler quota error retry/backoff, create burnout alerts for PLG keys.
PagerBot: Incident created in PagerDuty -> PD-INC-9987. On-call escalations configured.
OpsBot: Postmortem checklist created: /incidents/2148765432/checklist. Assigned owners: Marco, Raj, Linda. Priority: P1.
Linda SRE: final note before I go: we should add a short-term runbook step: on quotaExceeded, try route-to-dedicated and enable model_fallback flag. Documenting now.
Sam Oncall: Acknowledged. I'll coordinate the 1-hour update. :thumbsup:
Emily CS: Thanks team, prepping customers and billing note for routed traffic.
Linda SRE: logging out. Good work everyone. :heart:
